description: A false-colour infrared satellite image of Oger, Hungary, showing distinct land cover types. Areas of dense vegetation, likely forest or robust woody scrub, appear in shades of red. Agricultural fields or areas with less vegetation are depicted in greenish-blue tones. A prominent linear feature, interpreted as a transitional forest or line of trees and scrub, is highlighted by a thick pink outline, separating areas of dense red vegetation from greenish-blue fields. The image was captured using a Spot 5 sensor at 2.5 m resolution. The source data dates are 2006-07-28 and 2011-10-18. Source: CNES 2012©, Distribution Airbus DS/Spot Image. The image serves as an example for the classification of "Transitional woodland and scrub" (CORINE Land Cover (CLC) class 3.2.4) or "Lines of trees and scrub" within the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) nomenclature guidelines.
